# TestingWithEkki

> Grow beyond test execution through Web Automation lessons and hands-on challenges in Practice. Available in English (/en) and Indonesian (/id).

## Learn

- [Web Automation lessons](https://testingwithekki.com/en/learn): Lessons that build the foundations for Web Automation and Playwright.

## Practice

- [Practice challenges](https://testingwithekki.com/en/practice): Hands-on selector, JavaScript, TypeScript and Playwright challenges that run in the browser.
- [Leaderboard](https://testingwithekki.com/en/leaderboard): Community progress ranking.

## About

- [About](https://testingwithekki.com/en/about): Who is behind TestingWithEkki and how the site teaches.
- [Contact](https://testingwithekki.com/en/contact): Ways to get in touch.
- [Sitemap](https://testingwithekki.com/sitemap.xml): Full list of public pages.
